caption: The drawing features a square grid composed of nine smaller rectangles and squares of varying sizes and patterns. In the upper left, there is a small white square filled with a repeating black bird-like motif. Directly to its right is a larger, light brown square covered with a pattern of tan and white intersecting lines forming a grid. To the right of this is a tall, vertically oriented rectangle in a reddish-brown shade patterned with thin dark diagonal lines and three vertical yellow lines. Below the upper left square is a medium-sized tan rectangle with the same grid pattern as the larger square above it. In the center left is a large brownish rectangle with diagonal lines and dotted textures. At the center is a white square with the same black motif as the top left square. The bottom row, from left to right, contains a large reddish-brown rectangle with diagonal grid lines and horizontal yellow stripes; then, to the right, a smaller greenish square with a white marble-like pattern, and finally, a white square with vertical black lines and specks. The overall composition is a patchwork arrangement of these differently colored and patterned segments, forming a cohesive square on a plain, off-white background. There is some handwritten text in the lower left and below the grid.
title: Patchwork Quilt Squares (4)
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
